en: Black-and-white image of a large, cylindrical masonry tower on a hill, surrounded by trees and sloping terrain. The tower has a tall, smooth drum with small windows or slits and a prominent domed roof topped by a small lantern structure and cross-like finial. In the distance, partially hidden by trees, are a few buildings and a broad landscape. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
